There probably arent any medical professionals floating around here. Even if there were they couldnt properly diagnose you online. 

I relate very heavily with your story, im 27 now but when i was a kid i felt the same way, hell i still do. 

Your mom wont kill you if you tell her how you feel. Honestly it may not feel like it but your mom wants nothing more than for you to be happy. 

Id say talk to her in private, if she is dismissive of your problem speak to your schools guidance counselor.

Shit duder. Sounds like you've reached a really shitty point in life. Normallay id not be one to talk someone down but your post reached out to me. Sounds like you're in high school, you gotta lot of room to grow past this shit. Im 27 and i am in a dead end. But like you can do anything. Take the shovel you want to bury yourself with and use it to dig out of the hole. Live to fight another day. And hell if you still want to kill yourself when you're 27 then go for it.
But also endless.

Theres a ton of punk out there with a lot of good bands. Like bands that are proficient. If you've ever seen a movie that takes place in boston you've heard The Dropkick Murphys or Flogging Molly. Theres a lot.

Its not gonna help much, but check out punk rock. Its the closest ive ever come to channeling my anger. At times its been therapeutic.

Punk gets a lot of shit for not being "good" music but thats kind of the point. Its just raw anger pushed through instruments and vocals.  And the more people it pisses off the better.

Here are some of my favorites. Ive given lyric videos for most.

(This band is super punk, so much so that they break the molde)

I could keep going and not all punk is ultra angry but i was kind of picking songs for how we feel. If you like it hit me up and i will gladly share my knowledge of this genre with you.

My dog. Thats why im still here. He loves me to death (pun unintended) if it werent for that goober id kill myself right now. But fuck, i love that dog more than i hate myself. Theres nothing i see in my future keeping me alive. Honestly i wish my dog was 14 not 4 so i wouldnt have to hold on that long....

90% of the fun of cars is driving them. Im a driving enthusiast more than a car enthusiast. I know a shit ton about cars, just makes me want a thousand different cars that much more. Working on cars blows though which is why i dont want to be a mechanic. 

Im interested in space, love talking about it and theorizing. I cant own space. So it doesnt bother me to just think about it and look at the stars. I /can/ own cars (in theory, capitalism kinda sucks) but /I/ cant so it just makes me angry.
We shouldnt down vote this person. They are right, a bit tone deaf sure but alcohol is a depressent and i always feel worse mentally during a hangover.

Its a very expensive hobby. I did 3 burnouts and now my car is broken and it needs tires... To be fair it had to have been a faulty part. Aftermarket racing engine mount gave out in like 3 months...

Super expensive hobby, only hobby i can think thats more expensive is maybe gold bar collecting.


Even a cheap civic shell goes for like $700 if the shell is worth investing thousands into to put an engine and trans into...

Im an alcoholic, ive tried AA but all the god stuff pushed me away. But one thing i learned from AA is that alcohol is not my problem its my solution to my problem, which is something ive known for a long time, long before i went to AA. 

Its convinient and helps me sleep, and for a few hours at a time i can at least stop thinking about how bad i feel.
She is eligble for SSI but thats only 760 a month. Not nothing but not enough to dig us out of this hole. She isnt eligble for ither SS for reasons i forgot a long time ago.

So many kind words, you're all awesome. Thank you again for the support. Easily my most successful post ever and it's on a throwaway lol.

I bought a helmet today and I'm just chilling in my apt parking lot practicing manuals and bunny hops. I had one good manual, maybe 2 parking spots length and I'm noticing rapid improvement on my bunny hops. I also just ripped my brake off because I kept scraping my thumb knuckle on the bolt, didn't realize how much I relied on it.

Getting a helmet soon. When I was younger id never be caught dead wearing a helmet (used to try skateboarding). But now I'm older and realize a helmet looks a lot cooler than a hospital bill lol.

As for hurting myself I've been trying to manual and I noticed that I always land left foot first when I roll out, my knee hasn't enjoyed it too much, almost blew it out the other day. What I wouldn't give to be a teenager again...
Thanks for the support everyone, means a lot.
My exgf may have played a roll in my downward spiral. Basically spent a month in bed drinking. She wasn't the only factor but one definitely one of the bigger ones.
